title: static smp
description: Static SMP is a custom plugin smp with new weapons made by the developer. It is vanilla with SMP plugins to enhance gameplay.
body: Static SMP is a Survival MultiPlayer Server that has a custom plugin that creates custom weapons for players to use. Players can play in events, fights, and much more on the static SMP. The Static SMP is a one of a kind server that any player can enjoy. And with great moderation it has a active playerbase. Our discord [Discord](https://discord.gg/FsWtPwZrXb) has 100 members already.
